card.line: Philadelphia was a city in Asia Minor, home to one of the seven churches that Jesus wrote to in Revelation, and He praised it for staying faithful.

moments.title: Named among the seven churches
moments.text: John hears a loud voice tell him to write what he sees and send it to seven churches. Philadelphia is one of them.

moments.title: A letter to Philadelphia
moments.text: Jesus, who is holy and true, tells the church He has set an open door before it that no one can shut. The church had little strength, yet it kept His word and did not deny His name. He promises to keep them and says He is coming soon.
